# Mapbox attribution logo

`mapbox-logo.svg` is the unmodified logo embedded in Mapbox's official
[attribution example](https://docs.mapbox.com/help/dive-deeper/attribution/),
retrieved on 2026-10-16. It is included to identify Mapbox as the map provider,
not as an application logo. Mapbox's trademark and attribution requirements
apply. Preserve the logo and the map's separate text attribution when updating.
